meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: A goal-like loop that decomposes work into systematic, evidence-bound ultrawork steps. Use when the user wants a goal loop or durable, checkpointed execution.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把大目标拆成一步步可核对的执行,跑到一半也能存档接着跑
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常跑多步骤长任务,又希望中途能停、断了能接着跑
copy.tagline_en: Break a big goal into verifiable steps and run it through, resuming anytime
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run long multi-step tasks and want to pause and resume safely

howto.what: Claude 会把任务拆成一条条可核查的步骤，先按参考文件登记目标和成功标准，再用 ulw-loop 命令行记录进度与证据；长任务在中断或上下文丢失后能读取已有记录接着做，而不是重新规划。
howto.when: 当你提到 ulw-loop、ulw，或要求带检查点的长时目标执行、证据驱动的工作、手动 QA 等时，它会接管；每条命令都需要 --session-id。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 帮我登记这次的目标和成功标准
say.note: 它会先读参考文件再创建目标

say.text: 跑 ulw-loop status --json，说下当前进度和证据
say.note: 返回该会话的状态与下一步建议

say.text: 上个目标已完成，用新 session-id 开一份不相关的新工作
say.note: 不会去改动已完成的状态

howto.what_en: Claude decomposes work into evidence-bound steps: it registers goals by the define-goal reference, tracks progress and evidence with the ulw-loop CLI, and resumes from checkpoints after context loss instead of re-planning from scratch.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention ulw-loop or ulw, or ask for checkpointed long-running goal execution, evidence-led work, or manual QA. Every command needs a --session-id scope.

say_en.text: Use ulw-loop to register this run's goal and success criteria
say_en.note: It reads the reference first, then creates goals

say_en.text: Run ulw-loop status --json and report progress and evidence
say_en.note: Returns this session's state and next actions

say_en.text: That goal is complete; open new work with a fresh session-id
say_en.note: It won't touch the completed state
